purpose: Architecture fixture seeds and deterministic test-plan designs; never substitute for blinded gold or evaluated real observation.

cases.hypothesis: Transcode supported input to another supported container
cases.fixture_design: Controlled non-sensitive 2s fixture and explicit output file
cases.test_plan_design: run bounded native transcoding invocation; inspect exit code and output probe
cases.expected_observation_is_hypothesis: Successful verified output if codecs available; otherwise NARROW/BLOCKED
cases.risk_guard: No successful exit without parseable output

cases.test_plan_design: invoke with missing input and capture stderr/exit
cases.expected_observation_is_hypothesis: Nonzero exit expected; exact wording unproven
cases.risk_guard: A missing input must not be marked SUPPORTED

cases.hypothesis: Every codec is available in every build
cases.fixture_design: Query frozen execution target codec/encoder support
cases.test_plan_design: compare requested codec with target capabilities
exercise in throwaway directory with overwrite disallowed
cases.expected_observation_is_hypothesis: Expected refusal or bounded behavior; verify sentinel hash

cases.test_plan_design: load, groupby, aggregate with explicit dtype
cases.expected_observation_is_hypothesis: Check computed values and row-count invariants
cases.risk_guard: Do not infer precision from prose

cases.test_plan_design: attempt column selection in isolated process
cases.expected_observation_is_hypothesis: Capture exact exception type under pinned version
cases.risk_guard: Do not claim missing column is supported

cases.hypothesis: All CSV input types preserve types automatically
cases.test_plan_design: compare inferred dtype with explicit schema
cases.risk_guard: Do not silently coerce identifiers/leading zeros

cases.hypothesis: Null group keys always appear in grouped results
cases.fixture_design: CSV with null key and known options
Temporary isolated endpoint and short-lived credential
cases.test_plan_design: invoke publisher-supported API under read-only scope

cases.hypothesis: Unauthorized credential may list all buckets
cases.expected_observation_is_hypothesis: Expect denied/failed or explicitly scoped anonymous behavior

cases.hypothesis: Object listing implies access to object contents
cases.fixture_design: List scope but not get-object scope if available
cases.risk_guard: No conflation between list and read

cases.hypothesis: Every listed object is immediately downloadable
cases.fixture_design: Fixture with stale/removal race where safe
cases.test_plan_design: test listing then fetch under controlled state
cases.expected_observation_is_hypothesis: Observe failed fetch/currentness race and replay

cases.hypothesis: Convert ODT document to PDF headlessly
cases.fixture_design: Synthetic ODT in private temp directory
cases.test_plan_design: invoke official publisher binary headless conversion
cases.expected_observation_is_hypothesis: Inspect output existence, format and exit diagnostics
cases.risk_guard: Requires exact runtime manifest, output validation
No success based solely on exit code

cases.hypothesis: All filters work on all file formats
cases.fixture_design: Compare two formats and exporter filter support
cases.test_plan_design: review release-specific supported conversions before execution
cases.risk_guard: Do not infer source HEAD behavior for diverged release

cases.hypothesis: Conversion is stateless across profile conflicts
cases.fixture_design: Two isolated application profiles and temp files

lifecycle_assertions: DISCOVERED/HYPOTHESIZED/COMPILED cannot imply EVIDENCED or EXPORT_READY
REFUTED, BLOCKED and stale/version-mismatched evidence must prevent EXPORT_READY
Only replayable positive evidence scoped to source, execution target, environment, bindings and fixtures can support readiness
Every exported CLI/MCP/Skill projection must reference the same frozen Capability authority
